cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Asset-light IT/digital-commerce services model with no physical supply chain; 'Cost of Services' represents technology/development vendor and subcontractor spend, which is highly concentrated (top 10 suppliers were 90.88% of FY26 cost of services, up from 33.77% in FY24), indicating rising reliance on a small vendor base rather than backward integration.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Hybrid revenue mix (one-time project fees + recurring SaaS/retainer income) intended to smooth cash flows and reduce dependence on one-time engagements
- Revenue and EBITDA margin have scaled sharply (EBITDA margin 13.65% FY24 to 22.78% FY26) alongside revenue growth (71.93% 3-yr CAGR)
- Operating cash flow turned negative in FY26 (-Rs 110.04 lakh) despite rising PAT, indicating working-capital/receivables build-up as revenue scaled
- High customer concentration (top 10 customers ~69% of FY26 revenue) is a key driver/risk to revenue predictability
- Continued R&D investment (100+ dedicated employees) in AI/ML, GenAI, IoT, blockchain cited as needed to sustain competitiveness and margins

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Pursue SME digitization opportunities in India via ONDC and Digital India-linked programs
- Expand internationally into MENA, US and UK markets through global partners
- Develop proprietary SaaS and PaaS products, including AI-driven personalisation tools, to grow recurring revenue
- Pursue public-sector digitization opportunities (e.g. Smart Cities Mission, state e-commerce programs)
- Build strategic alliances with payment gateways, logistics firms and ERP vendors for bundled offerings

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No physical plant/capacity expansion (asset-light IT services model); forward intent is centred on international market expansion (MENA, US, UK) via global partners and continued build-out of proprietary SaaS/PaaS products to grow recurring, subscription-based revenue.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Established track record in ONDC integration and tailor-made e-commerce solutions
- Early-mover / certified Technology Service Provider (TSP) under government-backed ONDC initiative
- Diverse client base spanning reputed enterprises, global consumer brands and government-linked projects
- Hybrid revenue model blending one-time project fees with recurring SaaS/retainer income for stability
- Experienced leadership with strong industry and academic networks aiding client acquisition and talent hiring

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Customer concentration — Top 10 customers contributed 69.17% of FY26 revenue (60.12% FY25, 87.09% FY24); no long-term or exclusive customer agreements
- No long-term customer commitments — Absence of long-term/exclusive contracts means client relationships and revenue continuity depend on ongoing satisfaction, not contractual lock-in
- Reliance on third-party technology platforms — Heavy dependence on external/global technology providers and licences for service delivery
- Talent scalability — Challenges scaling technical talent in AI/ML, e-commerce development and ONDC compliance, seen as crucial to future growth
- Working-capital intensity — Operating cash flow turned negative (-Rs 110.04 lakh) in FY26 despite rising PAT, signalling receivables/WC build-up as revenue scaled
- Director experience documentation gap — Experience documents of two Independent Directors (Amita Agarwal, Prince Mishra) are stated as not traceable
- Competitive intensity — Increasing competition from global IT majors and niche local agencies may pressure pricing and margins
- Evolving regulatory environment — Changing e-commerce, taxation and data-privacy regulations could raise compliance costs and require operational changes

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Use fresh issue proceeds to enhance, maintain and upgrade existing products through manpower hiring**
- **Invest fresh issue proceeds in upgradation of IT infrastructure**
- **Repay borrowings using a portion of fresh issue net proceeds**
- **Pursue international expansion in MENA, US and UK markets through global partners**
- **Grow proprietary SaaS and PaaS product offerings, including AI-driven personalisation tools, to enhance recurring revenues**
- **Pursue long-term government contracts via public-sector digitization initiatives such as Smart Cities Mission**
- **Management flags dependence on a limited number of large customers with no long-term/exclusive agreements as a risk to revenue continuity**
- **Historical 3-year revenue CAGR reported as a scale/growth KPI tracked by management**
